matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Compact controlled cover, persons, non-operative counts, incident/procedure chronology, live-count map, issue list and statutory-deadline tracker; neutral trial orientation.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 8-12 pages; 300-500 words per narrative page or 10-24 sourced events/rows per table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF with searchable text, stable source links and compact repeated headers.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Pending witness state, corrected date and later count disposal retained in dated versions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Open orientation excludes privileged advice, protected contact data and unserved application material; role variants follow permissions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied statements, generic summary-trial guidance, repeated chronology or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Signed complainant/witness/officer statements, 999 and body-worn-video registers, native-media references, transcripts and continuity; records observation, availability and media completeness.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-26 pages; statements 250-450 words/page, transcripts 350-600 words/page, registers 8-22 rows/page and few necessary stills.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed statement scans, native audio/BWV retained externally, searchable transcripts and born-digital media/continuity registers.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Witness uncertainty, inaudible passage, BWV activation gap and corrected speaker label allowed with traceable history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Contact data, bystander imagery and irrelevant audio minimised; only served evidence reaches defence/client/court; masters restricted.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated statements, near-identical stills, transcript/media duplication, irrelevant BWV or decorative screenshots.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Damage complainant/owner statements, exhibit register, photographs, repair estimates/value records, CCTV media and continuity; tests ownership, damage, value and event identity separately.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; statements/records at authentic density, schedules 8-20 rows/page and 1-4 evidential images/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Signed statement and trade-document scans, native CCTV referenced by hash, original photographs with metadata and born-digital exhibit schedule.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Estimate rather than invoice, uncertain prior mark, camera-clock offset and corrected property label allowed with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Commercial/contact details and unrelated CCTV content minimised; served relevant evidence follows audience permissions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repetitive damage images, fabricated invoices, decorative CCTV stills, duplicate exhibits or price-list padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Custody record, rights/caution/legal-advice/rest/health and intoxication observations, interview plan, native audio register, whole transcript and completeness/gap log; primary safeguard and alleged-confession source.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-28 pages; custody/forms retain authentic whitespace, transcript 350-600 words/page and event/gap logs 8-20 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Scanned signed custody/forms where realistic, native interview audio retained by hash, born-digital searchable transcript and gap/completeness register.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Inaudible passage, short recording loss, conflicting intoxication observations and corrected transcript label allowed; no invented confession text.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Legal-advice content remains privileged; health data minimised; served interview material follows application/ruling and audience state.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated transcript, reconstructed missing audio, boilerplate custody pages, invented advice or artificial safeguard defects.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Defence section 76/78 application, prosecution response, evidence tendered on admissibility, hearing record, judicial ruling and permitted-use map; maintains application, ruling and evidential truth as separate states.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-22 pages; applications/responses 300-500 words/page, rulings 200-450 words/page and use maps 6-16 passages/rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital filed application/response, signed or sealed hearing/ruling record, and source-linked permitted-use schedule; no transcript text silently removed.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Amended ground, adjourned hearing, oral clarification and later corrected use map permitted with full history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privileged draft/advice restricted; filed/served materials available by role; client output explains state without privileged strategy.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No generic PACE essay, invented judicial reasons, repeated transcript, duplicate applications or concealment presented as repair.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: excluded wording not composed as fact

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Witness contact/availability log, warning and response, summons application, supporting grounds, court decision/order, service/attempts, attendance and compliance outcome; tracks each procedural transition.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 8-14 pages; contact/service logs 8-22 events/page and applications/orders at authentic sparse form density.
required_fields_headings_and_provenance: witness ID without unsafe contact detail
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital controlled logs, signed application and sealed/scanned order or refusal; service proof retained in native or scanned form.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Failed contact, changed availability, refused then renewed application and unsuccessful service permitted with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Witness addresses/contact routes restricted; client/court/CPS views reveal only necessary procedural status; internal safety notes remain controlled.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented contact attempts, duplicate logs, generic summons prose, repeated order pages or unsafe address replication.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Preparation for effective trial form/case-management record, hearsay and bad-character applications/responses, authorities index, hearing note and resulting orders; keeps party submissions and judicial permissions separate.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; forms/orders at authentic density, applications 300-500 words/page and authorities index 8-18 entries/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital prescribed-style forms and applications, public-authority links/index, plus signed or sealed court records; no copied judgments.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Amended time estimate, late response, withdrawn limb and varied direction allowed with complete history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Filed/served documents role-available; privileged preparation notes and internal authority analysis restricted; client version uses appropriate explanation.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied legal authorities, boilerplate legal tests, duplicate forms/orders, fake citations or artificial issue pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: authority links resolve at review date

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: PC3 discontinuance notice and service, prosecution opening/closure state, defence no-case submission, response, ruling, verdict reasons and count-level dismissal/acquittal/final orders; preserves distinct termination routes.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; notices/orders at authentic density, submissions 300-500 words/page and count-state tables 5-12 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital notices/submissions and signed or sealed court records; concise count-lifecycle schedule links each operative source.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Corrected count reference, reserved ruling and later perfected reasons allowed without changing earlier state silently.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Filed/open outcomes available appropriately; privileged draft submission restricted; victim/witness personal data minimised.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented verdict reasons, repeated orders, generic no-case law, duplicate count tables or hidden unsafe wording counted as repair.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Non-sensitive disclosure schedules, service logs, defence statement state, statutory-time-limit and court-deadline tracker, hearing record and trial/sentence preparation; compact readiness control.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; schedules/trackers 10-25 rows/page, statements 250-450 words/page and forms at authentic density.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital schedules/trackers and signed/scanned defence or court forms where realistic; stable row IDs and no hidden spreadsheet content.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Supplemental item, amended defence statement, corrected calculation and varied direction allowed with audit trail.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privileged defence drafts/internal advice restricted; served statement and disclosure follow authorised audiences; personal sentencing data minimised.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No empty schedule rows, repeated deadline tables, generic disclosure prose, duplicate forms or speculative sentence outcome.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: time limit not inferred as expired
